items.title: Mark Wahlberg wants to take on the longevity-startup crowd with an affordable gym concept
items.title_cn: 马克·沃尔伯格（ Mark Wahlberg ）希望以经济实惠的健身房概念来迎接长寿的创业人群

items.summary_cn: 马克·沃尔伯格（ Mark Wahlberg ）曾经把钱投入了一家被纽约证券交易所踢出的健身房连锁店，现在他正在建造自己的健身房，他向你保证，你会在不需要信托基金的情况下得到一个冷落，一个血液面板和一个蛋白质松饼。

items.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
items.title_cn: 首席执行官表示， Replit不再与Anthropic合作
items.summary: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer with Anthropic.
items.summary_cn: 马萨德说，做出这一决定有许多不同的原因，包括成本。Replit于8月宣布与OpenAI建立合作伙伴关系，但从未有任何迹象表明它不再与Anthropic合作。
items.comment: API 上线了，功能强大但按量付费，小团队用前要算好账。

items.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
items.title_cn: 印度成为报告流氓AI代理活动的最新国家
items.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
items.summary_cn: 代理通过应用配置、公共代码存储库和过于宽松的云角色中暴露的凭据和连接设置进入。
items.comment: 政策收紧，大厂合规团队又要扩编了，创新空间还剩多少？

items.title: Show HN: Fakeipedia – Wikipedia for worlds that don't exist
items.title_cn: Show HN: Fakeipedia –不存在世界的维基百科
items.summary: Hi HN! Fakeipedia is an automatic world-building platform which takes an imagined world and makes a whole wiki that you can endlessly explore by clicking red links. I came up with this idea a few months ago after playing around with worldbuilding in Gemini, but I didn't want to release it until a powerful enough model could do it justice, and I decided that Argon is creative enough to write articles that are worth reading. I was surprised how well it turned out and how engaging some of the writi
items.summary_cn: HN ，您好！ Fakeipedia是一个自动构建世界的平台，它采用了一个想象中的世界，并创建了一个完整的维基，您可以通过点击红色链接无休止地探索。几个月前，我在双子座玩过世界建筑之后想出了这个主意，但在一个足够强大的模型可以做到公正之前，我不想发布它，我决定Argon有足够的创造力来写出值得阅读的文章。我很惊讶它的结果有多好，以及一些作品的吸引力有多大
